cordy__connect.title: Cordy Mini Kit
cordy__connect.descriptions: lightweight and customizable wallet connector built for Web3 applications. Inspired by RainbowKit, it streamlines wallet integration while keeping the developer experience simple and flexible. With a focus on speed, ease of use, and seamless UI customization, Cordy Minikit empowers dApps to onboard users effortlessly.
